# Multi-Carrier Tracking MCP

> Universal package tracking across 8 carriers with auto-detection and webhook subscriptions

This MCP server exposes 5 tools via the Model Context Protocol (JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP POST). It runs on Cloudflare Workers and is billed via Dodo Payments. Authenticated via `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` obtained by subscribing at `https://multi-carrier-tracking-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/upgrade`.

## Endpoint
- MCP JSON-RPC: https://multi-carrier-tracking-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/mcp
- Health: https://multi-carrier-tracking-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/health
- Landing page: https://multi-carrier-tracking-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/
- Get API key: https://multi-carrier-tracking-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/upgrade?tier=solo

## Tools
- `track_package`: Current status + event history for one package. Auto-detects carrier.
- `track_multiple`: Batch tracking with per-package carrier auto-detection.
- `detect_carrier`: Identify which carrier a tracking number belongs to (with ambiguity candidates).
- `list_carriers`: Supported carriers and their countries.
- `subscribe_tracking`: Webhook subscription on status transitions.

## Authentication
Pass `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` on POST /mcp. Free tier: anonymous, 100 calls / month / IP.

## Pricing
- Free: 100 calls / month (anonymous, no signup)
- Solo $9/mo: 2,000 calls / month, 60/min
- Team $29/mo: 10,000 calls / month, 200/min, 5 team seats
- Pro $79/mo: 50,000 calls / month, 600/min, 25 team seats
Billed via Dodo Payments (merchant-of-record). Cancel anytime.

## Account management
- View account: GET https://multi-carrier-tracking-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/account (Bearer)
- Rotate key: POST https://multi-carrier-tracking-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/account/rotate (Bearer)
- GDPR data export: GET https://multi-carrier-tracking-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/account/export (Bearer)
- Team management (Team+): https://multi-carrier-tracking-mcp.atlasword.workers.dev/account/team
